status: Implemented; build, default, Worker and benchmark validation passed
change: AggregateGroup caches the immutable serialized key/alias header instead of snapshotting keys and remeasuring alias names per row. State iteration no longer creates Object.entries arrays. AggregateMemory admits its accounting directory and first per-group record, then mutates that record on subsequent updates instead of allocating replacement records. Exact serialized-size boundaries are unchanged.

cases: Existing exact serialized-size and one-byte-short tests across Unicode, duplicate values and restored state
Independent seven-aggregate oracle at 1024,4096,16384 rows with serialized-size accounting enabled
Four concurrent 16384-row jobs at 64/128 MiB pool caps; final usage zero

benchmarkLimits: Current baseline only; timings ran alongside regression suites and are not an isolated pre/post comparison. Local scanner and reservation counters do not certify total heap or remote behavior.
remaining: Count/sum/avg/variance/min/max now measure directly (linked evidence). Initial header and first/last/any snapshot estimation remain outstanding.
Growing-state bookkeeping returns temporary size records and formats changed values.
AggregateMemory metadata is admitted, but arbitrary expression and request-compatibility temporaries remain outside this change.
